correctness.rationale: The four-qubit Pauli and spin-flip expansion establishes sum of balanced purities >=1 for all pure states; Gaussian-integer parity forces each phase-restricted purity into (1/64)Z and hence worst-cut >=11/32. The concrete 16-entry phase array has three exact Gram numerators 88/256. Gauge removal is unique; the C++17 exhaustive loop checks all 4^11 classes and all equality cases and symmetry images; an independent Python matrix implementation confirms the representative/orbit and the real-sign threshold. The inference is finite-exhaustive where appropriate, not extrapolated from samples.

value.rationale: The alphabet {1,i,-1,-i} is a natural discrete set of controlled phase-gate resources for flat qubit fiducials, and the bottleneck 2|2 purity determines the weakest balanced bipartite Rényi-2 entanglement across all outcomes of locally Z-encoded measurement bases. An exact best possible value, 96-case equality classification as a single symmetry orbit, and strict improvement from the real-only 3/8 bound are motivated structural and design facts, not arbitrary parameter slices or code-only novelty. No global quantum advantage or noise-robustness claim is made.
